otherDetail: Other income, net was $3M — small next to the main business.

segments.name: Transaction-based revenues
segments.note: Fees from customers' trades — options $265M, crypto $160M and equities $66M.

segments.name: Net interest revenues
segments.note: Interest on customers' cash and margin loans, plus securities lending.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Mostly Robinhood Gold subscriptions — 3.5M subscribers, up 76%.

takeaways.text: Transaction revenue rose 65% — crypto revenue nearly doubled to $160M and options brought in $265M as customers traded actively.
takeaways.title: Trading boomed

takeaways.text: Total platform assets rose 99% to $279B, helped by $13.8B of net deposits in the quarter and higher market values.
takeaways.title: Assets on the platform doubled

takeaways.text: Robinhood Gold subscribers rose 76% to 3.5M, and in June the company closed its Bitstamp acquisition, expanding its crypto business worldwide.
takeaways.title: Gold keeps growing

verdict: Robinhood's revenue jumped 45% to $989M as options and crypto trading surged — and it more than doubled its profit to $386M.
